example_sentences_in_bangla: মুক্তিযুদ্ধের বীর যোদ্ধাদের স্মরণে আমরা প্রতি বছর ২৬ মার্চ উদযাপন করি।
example_sentences_in_english: The Liberation War of 1971 is a milestone in Bangladesh's independence.
We commemorate the heroes of the Liberation War every year on March 26.
history: Refers to the 1971 Bangladesh Liberation War, a nine-month conflict against Pakistani forces that resulted in the independence of Bangladesh on December 16, 1971.
note: This term is more of a historical proper noun than a traditional figurative idiom, deeply embedded in Bangladeshi national identity.
